# @herowcode/utils

> Tree-shakable TypeScript utilities for Node.js and browsers (ESM + CJS, `sideEffects: false`). Import from the subpath of the module you need; check this file before writing a helper by hand.

Install: `pnpm add @herowcode/utils`. Optional peers: `pino`, `pino-pretty` (only for `/logger` on Node).

## Import rules

- Root `@herowcode/utils` re-exports only `array`, `function` and `string`. Every other module is subpath-only: `import { retry } from "@herowcode/utils/async"`.
- `/files`, `/logger` and `/youtube` resolve to a browser or Node build through export conditions; the same import works in both, and unsupported calls fall back safely.
- Full per-function docs: `docs/<module>.md` in the repo (https://github.com/herowcode/js-utils/tree/main/docs). Migration guide for replacing local copies: `docs/replacing-local-copies.md`.

## Modules

### array — `@herowcode/utils/array` (also root)
chunk, groupBy, keyBy, shuffle, sumBy, unique

### async — `@herowcode/utils/async`
- retry: retry an async fn with backoff
- backoffDelay: compute a backoff delay
- parseRetryAfterMs: parse a `Retry-After` header into ms
- sleep (abortable), withTimeout
- createConcurrencyLimiter, createSingleFlight (dedupe in-flight calls), mapInChunks
- clampTimerDelay, MAX_TIMER_DELAY: keep `setTimeout` delays in range

### auth — `@herowcode/utils/auth`
decodeJWT, getJWTExp, isJWTExpired, isJWTExpiring, extractBearerToken (no signature verification)

### api — `@herowcode/utils/api`
apiClient (fetch wrapper with retry, timeout, redirect and Retry-After handling), buildQueryString, buildPageMeta, getOffset (pagination helpers)

### br — `@herowcode/utils/br` (Brazil)
formatCPF, formatCNPJ, formatCEP, isValidCPF, isValidCNPJ

### crypto — `@herowcode/utils/crypto` (Web Crypto)
sha256Hex, hmacSha256Hex, verifyHmacSignature, safeEqual (constant-time compare), generateOpaqueToken

### date — `@herowcode/utils/date`
- dayjs (preconfigured) plus setDayjsGlobalIntl / getDayjsGlobalIntl / resetDayjsGlobalIntl / withDayjsGlobalIntl
- formatDate, getRelativeTime, parseTimeSpent
- getDateInUTC, getCurrentDateInUTC, fixTimezoneOffset
- dayjs-free ISO-date helpers: addDaysISO, diffDaysISO, getTodayISODate, toISODate, parseISODateLocal, getZonedHour, getDatePartsInTimeZone

### env — `@herowcode/utils/env`
requireEnv (throws if missing), optionalEnv, parseBoolean, readEnv, resolveEnv

### errors — `@herowcode/utils/errors`
- HttpError and subclasses: BadRequestError, UnauthorizedError, ForbiddenError, NotFoundError, ConflictError, TooManyRequestsError
- isHttpError, getErrorMessage, getErrorStatus, getRootCause, walkCause
- isTransientStatus, isTransientNetworkError, TRANSIENT_STATUS_CODES: decide whether to retry

### files — `@herowcode/utils/files`
formatBytes, toCSV, safeStorage (never-throwing localStorage/sessionStorage), compressImage, copyToClipboard, downloadBlob, downloadUrl, fileExists, fileDelete (Node fs)

### function — `@herowcode/utils/function` (also root)
debounce, throttle, tryCatch, tryCatchResult (errors as values), safeJsonParse, isBrowser, isServer

### http — `@herowcode/utils/http` (fetch/Response based, edge-safe)
fetchJson, fetchWithTimeout, jsonResponse, corsHeaders, preflight

### logger — `@herowcode/utils/logger`
createLogger (pino on Node, console in browser, secrets redacted), createPinoInstance (Node), redactDeep, redactSecrets

### number — `@herowcode/utils/number`
formatNumber, formatCurrency, formatPercent, percentOf, toNumber, parseLocaleNumber

### phone — `@herowcode/utils/phone`
parsePhone, formatPhone, normalizePhone, onlyDigits, getBRMobileVariants, buildWhatsAppLink

### string — `@herowcode/utils/string` (also root)
- case: camelCase, kebabCase, snakeCase, capitalize, toSentenceCase
- text: slugify, truncate, pluralize, getInitials, normalizeText, removeAccents
- markup: escapeHtml, removeHtmlTags, markdownToText, escapeRegExp
- time strings: formatSecondsToHMS, formatSecondsToFragment, formatHMSToSeconds, formatStringToTime

### youtube — `@herowcode/utils/youtube`
extractYouTubeId, generateYoutubeURL, validateYoutubeLink, getYoutubeVideoInfo, getYoutubeThumbnail, getYoutubeVideoDuration

## Conventions

- Interfaces are `I*`, type aliases `T*`, enums `E*`.
- Misconfiguration errors carry a `HEROW_*` code and a docs link (`docs/errors.md`).
- Prefer these helpers over local copies of retry, sleep, HTTP errors, env parsing, HMAC, JWT decoding, phone/CPF/CNPJ formatting and similar.
